capabilities: : Show note content as card cover
: Size cards dynamically to content height
: Search within note bodies across the base
intentEvidence: An Obsidian Bases view that shows notes as cards — using the note's own content as the cover, where the built-in Cards view puts an image.
problem: The standard Bases view only displays titles or images, preventing users from seeing the actual content of a note directly on the card.
summary: Bases Content Cards transforms the Obsidian Bases view to display note bodies as card covers instead of images, allowing users to preview content directly within the base.
